entities.summary: Joseph Hilongwa Jermia is a boxer from Namibia, who participated in the 2004 Summer Olympics for his native African country. There he was stopped in the quarterfinals of the light flyweight division by Russia's eventual bronze medal winner Sergey Kazakov.
